title: Policyholder Tenure Bonus on Deductible Rewards Claim-Free Credit, Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage
content:
Cardinal Mutual adds a tenure bonus to the Deductible Rewards claim-free credit of vehicles insured under Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage, measured by the inception date of the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy the vehicle is scheduled on.

**Terms.** Where the auto policy's inception date is at least 120 whole months before the grant date, 25 is added; where it is at least 60 but fewer than 120 whole months before, 10 is added; otherwise nothing is added. The bonus is added to the annual credit, and it is that sum which is reduced to the room left under the credit cap.

Whole months are complete calendar months from the inception date to the grant date. The inception date is read from the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy record.

| Whole months from inception to the grant date | Bonus (USD) |
|---|---|
| 120 or more | 25 |
| 60 to 119 | 10 |
| Fewer than 60 | 0 |

## Boundary illustrations (hypothetical dates)

- Inception on 2016-05-20; grant on 2026-05-20: 120 whole months, 25. Grant on 2026-05-19: 119 whole months, 10.
- Inception on 2021-05-20; grant on 2026-05-20: 60 whole months, 10. Grant on 2026-05-19: 59 whole months, 0.
